title: Ensemble Normalized Comment List Schema
description: Schema for the toolchain's normalized 'comment list' shape (TRD-2026-8d825f54 TRD-012/TRD-033, PRD REQ-002, REQ-022). A tracker-category adapter capability that returns a work item's comments (`tracker.comments`) maps its tool's raw stdout into this shape via packages/development/lib/toolchain/mapping.js#mapOutput. packages/development/lib/toolchain/runner.js's CAPABILITY_NORMALIZED_SCHEMA selects this schema for 'tracker.comments' specifically, the same way it selects work-item-list.json for 'tracker.list' -- see that schema's own description for why this must be a separate schema from work-item.json's single-item, 'id'-required shape.

comments.description: Comments on the work item, in source-tool order; the same unconstrained-beyond-'object' shape work-item.json's own 'comments' property documents (TRD-012's Implementation AC and System Architecture section document only that 'comments[]' exists, not a normalized comment shape).
